title: Zeros and Coefficients of Polynomials
summary: Reading zeros from graphs, and the sum and product of the zeros of a quadratic.
objectives: I can find the zeros of a polynomial from its graph.
I can use sum = −b/a and product = c/a.
I can build a quadratic from given zeros.
misconceptions: A quadratic always has two zeros.
The sum of zeros is b/a.
Zeros are where the graph crosses the y-axis.
